range_onset_bidirectional_v1|SOL.interpretation: SOL near misses were materially negative despite two cost-clearing closes. Removing the hourly-cross or 5-minute regime requirements is not supported.

entry_gate_disposition.reason: Every route with resolved independent 60-minute near misses was negative after largest-observation removal. Loosening a gate would increase frequency without current evidence of positive after-cost expectancy.
entry_gate_disposition.confidence: medium for this frozen short window; low for long-run expectancy
entry_gate_disposition.falsifier: A later predeclared independent window produces positive after-cost and ex-largest outcomes for one exact blocker with stable directional and regime slices.

sol_exit_review.interpretation: The first v49 eligible path rose enough to arm all three predeclared profit locks, then gave back the move and became negative under exact visible-depth marking. This is direct forward evidence of the suspected winner-giveback failure mode, but it remains one unresolved counterfactual lifecycle.

exit_disposition.reason: The 25/15/10 policy captured the most estimated net value in this path, but selecting it now would fit one lifecycle. All three policies remain measured on every later eligible path under frozen parameters.
exit_disposition.confidence: low-medium on the failure mode; low on the eventual winning policy
exit_disposition.falsifier: Later independent lifecycles show the native exit outperforming the frozen locks after fees, funding, added slippage, and largest-winner removal.

risks_and_limitations: The SOL lifecycle is simulated from recorded visible depth and is not a live IOC fill.
Profit-lock exits use causal completed candles and measured taker fees but exclude added trigger slippage and pre-trigger funding.
Independent near-miss paths are sparse and cannot establish long-run expectancy.
The observer has no execution authority and this report makes no portfolio PnL claim.
